name: Mentor Admin Username and Email Change
author: Sabbir Islam

sections.description:
Mentor Admin Username and Email Change is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that allows administrators to quickly modify the admin user’s username, display name, email, and password from the WordPress dashboard.

By default, WordPress does not allow username changes, and updating the admin email requires verification. This plugin bypasses those limitations, enabling instant updates without requiring confirmation emails.

🔹 Features:
✅ Change the admin username directly from the dashboard.
✅ Update the admin email without email verification.
✅ Modify the display name to personalize your admin profile.
✅ Set a new password securely without needing a reset link.
✅ Simple and intuitive settings page under the “Users” menu.
✅ No coding or database modifications required.
✅ Secure updates with nonce verification.
✅ Works seamlessly with all WordPress themes and plugins.

🔹 How It Works:
Install and activate the plugin.
Navigate to Users → Admin Info Changer in your WordPress dashboard.
Enter the new username, display name, email, or password.
Click “Save Changes” – the updates apply instantly!
🚀 Perfect for developers, security-conscious site owners, or anyone who needs to modify admin credentials without hassle.
sections.installation:
Here’s a well-structured Installation Instructions section for your Mentor Admin Username and Email Change plugin:

Installation Instructions
Automatic Installation (Recommended)
Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
Go to Plugins → Add New.
In the search bar, type “Mentor Admin Username and Email Change”.
Click “Install Now” next to the plugin.
Once installed, click “Activate” to enable the plugin.
Navigate to Users → Admin Info Changer to update admin details.
Manual Installation
Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
Click “Choose File”, select the downloaded ZIP file, and click “Install Now”.
After installation, click “Activate”.
Go to Users → Admin Info Changer to update your admin details.
Installation via FTP (Advanced Users)
Download the plugin ZIP file and extract it on your computer.
Open an FTP client (e.g., FileZilla) and connect to your website.
Upload the extracted folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
Go to Plugins and find Mentor Admin Username and Email Change.
Click “Activate”.
Access the settings under Users → Admin Info Changer.
✅ Done! You can now update your admin username, email, name, and password easily from the dashboard. 🚀
sections.faq:
1. What does this plugin do?

This plugin allows WordPress administrators to update the admin user’s username, display name, email, and password directly from the dashboard without requiring email verification.

2. Can I change the username of any user?

No, this plugin only allows updating the details of the default admin user (ID 1).

3. Why am I seeing a “You do not have permission to perform this action” error?

This error occurs if your current user does not have the necessary “manage_options” capability. Ensure that you are logged in as an Administrator.

4. Is changing the WordPress admin username safe?

Yes, changing the username can improve security. However, WordPress does not allow changing usernames through the admin panel by default. This plugin modifies the username directly in the database.

5. Will this plugin send an email verification when I change the admin email?

No, this plugin bypasses WordPress email verification, so the email is changed instantly without requiring confirmation.

6. Can I reset the admin password if I forget it?

No, this plugin does not provide password recovery. If you forget your password, use the WordPress password reset option on the login screen.

7. Will changing the admin email affect website notifications?

Yes, after changing the email, all WordPress notifications (like password reset emails, admin alerts, etc.) will be sent to the new email address.

8. Why is my username not updating?

WordPress does not allow duplicate usernames. If the new username you entered already exists, it will not be changed.

9. Is this plugin compatible with multisite (WordPress Network)?

No, this plugin currently does not support WordPress Multisite.

10. Can I deactivate the plugin after changing my admin details?

Yes, once you update your admin username, email, name, or password, the changes are permanent, and you can deactivate or delete the plugin safely.
